landing.heroTitle: The CMS your clients will love
landing.heroDescription: Sumaq CMS gives you a powerful, Git-backed content management system with a beautiful visual editor — no code required.
landing.featuresDescription: Built for agencies and their clients, Sumaq CMS combines simplicity with power.
landing.feature1Desc: All changes are committed to your GitHub repository, giving you full version history.
landing.feature2Desc: Schema-driven forms let editors update content without ever touching code.
landing.feature3Desc: Manage unlimited sites from a single dashboard with role-based access.
landing.feature4Desc: Built-in internationalization so your CMS speaks your clients' language.
landing.feature5Desc: Integrated with Vercel for instant previews and one-click production deploys.
landing.feature6Desc: Self-host on your own infrastructure or use our managed cloud offering.

history.label: Your story
history.placeholder: Ex: From a young age I was fascinated by understanding the human mind. After years of training in clinical psychology, I discovered my calling in guiding people through times of change...

motivation.label: Your motivation
motivation.placeholder: Ex: What drives me every day is seeing the transformation in my patients. I believe in the potential of each person to heal and grow...

therapeuticApproach.label: Therapeutic approach
therapeuticApproach.placeholder: Ex: Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy integrated with Mindfulness and a humanistic approach

methods.label: Methods & techniques
methods.placeholder: Ex: EMDR, conscious breathing, cognitive restructuring

targetConditions.label: Conditions you treat
targetConditions.placeholder: Ex: Anxiety, depression, trauma, post-traumatic stress

idealPatientDescription.label: Ideal patient description
idealPatientDescription.placeholder: Ex: Adults aged 25-55 seeking self-understanding, anxiety management, or overcoming emotional blocks. Professionals who feel their personal or professional life isn't flowing as they'd like...

concerns.label: Main presenting concerns
concerns.placeholder: Ex: Generalized anxiety, grief, relationship issues

firstSessionDescription.label: What is the first session like?
firstSessionDescription.placeholder: Ex: The first session is a safe space to get to know each other. We start with an open interview exploring your history and reasons for seeking therapy. There's no rush; you set the pace...

preparationGuide.label: Preparation guide
preparationGuide.placeholder: Ex: You don't need to prepare anything special. Wear comfortable clothes and, if you wish, jot down a few topics you'd like to discuss. The most important thing is to come with the willingness to explore...

expectedOutcome.label: What can the patient expect?
expectedOutcome.placeholder: Ex: By the end of the first session, you'll have a clearer understanding of what you want to work on and how we can address it together...

slidingScale.label: I offer sliding scale based on income

waitlistPolicy.label: Waitlist management
waitlistPolicy.placeholder: Ex: I currently have immediate availability. If there is a waitlist, I'll notify you at least one week in advance when a slot opens...

emergencyProtocol.label: Emergency protocol
emergencyProtocol.placeholder: Ex: This is not an emergency service. If you are in crisis or having suicidal thoughts, please contact emergency services at 999 or go to the nearest emergency room...

officeAtmosphere.label: Office atmosphere
officeAtmosphere.placeholder: Ex: My office is a bright and calm space in the city center. Comfortable, decorated with plants and warm tones that invite tranquility...

coreValues.label: Core values of your practice
coreValues.placeholder: Ex: Confidentiality, respect, empathy, non-judgment, professionalism

whatINot.label: What you ARE NOT / do NOT do
whatINot.placeholder: Ex: I am not a therapist who gives quick advice or magic solutions. I do not do online diagnoses or write prescriptions...
